_comment: Date phrases a not-yet-published source dates itself with instead of a year — APA 'in press', 'forthcoming', etc. An entry carrying one is indexed under a no-year key, and a citation carrying one ('(Author, in press)') is matched to it. Editable without touching code. All phrases fold to a single no-year key, so a citation and its entry meet even when worded slightly differently; two such works by one author in one year stay ambiguous (reported, not guessed).
